column1: Table 6: Proportion of Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander (First Nations) people aged 2 and over who consumed sweetened beverages, by age group, 2012–13 and 2023
# proportion has a high margin of error and should be used with caution.
n.p not available for publication as estimate has a relative standard error greater than 50%, but included in the totals where applicable, unless otherwise stated.
Data in this table use ABS published data with have been randomly adjusted to avoid the release of confidential data. Discrepancies may occur between sums of the component items and totals.
See the ABS methodology for definitions of sweetened beverages
1. Sex recorded at birth refers to what was determined by sex characteristics observed at birth or infancy.
2.  Includes persons whose sex recorded at birth was another term (other than male or female).
3.  Includes beverages reported as consumed on day prior to interview (Day 1).
4. 95% CI = 95% confidence interval. We can be 95% confident that the true value is within this confidence interval.
